Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

translations.web: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.
translations.bsb: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
translations.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
translations.asv: The things which ye both learned and received and heard and saw in me, these things do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
